Privacy policy

Your note is a conversation starter. It is not a newsletter subscription.

Last updated: September 22, 2026

Who is responsible

Made Beside is based in Ontario, Canada. Our team handles privacy questions and requests at hello@madebeside.com. This policy covers this website and inquiries made through it.

What the form collects

The form asks for an email address and a message. Your name is optional. It also records a random submission reference, the time received, an expiry date and the version of the inquiry consent you accepted. Please do not include payment details, identity documents, health information, passwords or confidential project material. There are no attachment uploads.

Why your information is used

Your details are used to receive and respond to your inquiry, discuss the work you requested and protect the form against misuse. The form does not enrol you in marketing. Your information is not sold, used for targeted advertising or added to a mailing list. Separate purposes require an appropriate legal basis and, where required, fresh consent.

Service providers and international processing

The published website uses OpenAI Sites hosting and its infrastructure, including Cloudflare. Website inquiries are stored in a database restricted to the site operator; there is no public inquiry directory. Hosting, security and email providers may process information to deliver their services. Network requests can include your IP address, browser information and technical logs, even though the inquiry database does not store your IP address. Processing may occur outside Canada, including in the United States, where local laws can apply. Information may also be disclosed when required by law.

Portfolio and owner studio

The studio is restricted to the site owner using the hosting platform’s signed-in identity. The owner uploads photos, videos, descriptions and optional captions. Drafts and archived pieces are restricted to the owner; published pieces are visible to the site’s permitted audience. Media is stored with the hosting provider and served directly, without third-party video embeds. Portfolio files remain until removed by the operator; archiving hides a piece but does not delete it. Contact us about a depicted person’s privacy or permissions.

Retention

Website inquiry records become eligible for deletion after 90 days. Cleanup runs when the website receives activity, at most once an hour; deletion can be delayed when the site is inactive. Copies in email, project records, provider backups or records required by law can have different retention periods. Information needed for a client engagement is handled for that engagement and retained only as needed for its purpose and legal obligations.

Your choices and requests

You can choose email instead of the form. Contact hello@madebeside.com to ask about access, correction, deletion or withdrawing consent. Reasonable identity verification may be needed, and legal requirements can limit deletion or access. Withdrawing permission to use necessary contact details may prevent a reply or continued service. Requests will be addressed within applicable legal timelines. You can also contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

Safeguards and cookies

Access restrictions, encrypted connections on the hosted site, limited form fields and input checks help protect information. No system can guarantee absolute security. The site application has no advertising pixels, visitor analytics, session replay, third-party content embeds. A session-storage flag remembers whether the opening animation has played in the current tab; it is not used for tracking. See the cookie policy for the distinction between this application and hosting services.

Updates

Changes will be dated on this page. A policy update alone does not authorize a new use of previously collected information when additional consent is required.

Vimeo videos

Portfolio videos use Vimeo. Muted background videos load when their section enters view while motion is enabled. Vimeo then receives connection information, including your IP address, and may use browser storage. We request Vimeo’s do-not-track mode. See Vimeo’s privacy policy for its practices.

Service descriptions are general and may change. Marketing results depend on many factors and no specific audience growth, revenue, ranking or campaign outcome is promised. Reasonable care is taken with the site, but uninterrupted availability or error-free content is not guaranteed. This does not exclude any obligation, remedy or liability that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

Privacy and external links

The privacy policy explains handling of inquiries. Links to other websites are provided for convenience; those sites have their own policies. Sending an inquiry does not authorize unrelated promotional emails.

Applicable law and your rights

Ontario law and applicable federal Canadian law govern these website terms, subject to mandatory protections that apply where you live. Nothing here takes away non-waivable consumer rights, imposes mandatory arbitration, or prevents a complaint to an appropriate regulator. A separate signed project agreement governs the services it covers, subject to applicable law.

Changes and contact

The date below identifies this version. Changes do not retroactively alter a signed project agreement. Contact hello@madebeside.com about a concern or an error.

Cookie policy

No advertising cookies. No visitor analytics added to this website.

Last updated: September 22, 2026

Loading animation preference

A session-storage flag remembers that the opening animation has been shown in this tab, so it does not repeat as you navigate. It contains no contact details and is not used for analytics or advertising.

What this application uses

The website application does not set cookies or use local storage, advertising pixels, session replay, browser fingerprinting or visitor analytics. Fonts and visual elements are served with the site. There are no embedded social feeds, maps or video players that load third-party tracking content. The motion preference exists only in the current page and resets when it is reloaded.

Hosting and access services

Hosting and access providers may use necessary security, routing or sign-in technologies and maintain technical logs. A private site preview may require provider authentication. Those services are separate from optional tracking configured by Made Beside. This policy does not claim that the browser, hosting platform or other websites never use cookies.

Why there is no optional-cookie banner

No optional tracking is configured in the site application, so it does not show an accept-all advertising or analytics banner. If optional tracking or third-party embeds are introduced, their purposes, providers and consent requirements must be reviewed before they are enabled. Where prior consent is required, those technologies must stay off until you choose them.

Your controls

Your browser can restrict or clear cookies. Restricting necessary provider cookies may affect sign-in or access. Questions about this website can be sent to hello@madebeside.com. See the privacy policy for inquiry handling.

Cancellations & refunds

No checkout. No payment just to say hello.

Last updated: September 22, 2026

Website inquiries are free

This website does not take payments or automatically create a paid booking. Sending a contact form does not commit you to a purchase.

Project terms come first

Before paid work begins, the project agreement should specify the payment schedule, deposits, expenses, cancellation or rescheduling conditions, completed-work charges and any refund arrangements. There is no blanket non-refundable deposit rule or universal cancellation fee established by this page.

How to make a request

Email hello@madebeside.com with your name, project reference and a brief explanation of your cancellation or refund request. Do not send card details or banking credentials. The request will be reviewed against the agreed terms, work completed, authorized commitments and applicable law. Any amount or timing will be confirmed in writing; this page does not promise a particular discretionary refund.

Rights under law

Applicable statutory cancellation and refund rights take priority over any conflicting project term. Where a refund is legally required, it is not conditional on discretionary approval. Nothing on this page limits rights that cannot lawfully be waived.

/accessibility:
Accessibility

The story should be available to everyone.

Last updated: September 22, 2026

Using this website

The site is designed with semantic headings, visible keyboard focus, labelled fields and descriptive errors. The main information is available as text; decorative visual effects are hidden from assistive technology. You do not need to drag objects or interact with an animation to read the services.

Motion and reading

Use “Pause motion” at the bottom of the screen to stop decorative movement. The website also responds to your device’s reduced-motion preference. Service descriptions remain readable when motion is paused. A basic agency introduction and email contact are available when JavaScript is disabled. No audio plays automatically.

Contact and alternatives

If something is difficult to use, email hello@madebeside.com. Tell us which page or task caused difficulty and your preferred way to receive the information. You do not need to disclose a diagnosis. An accessible alternative can be discussed with you.

Ongoing improvement

Accessibility is an ongoing responsibility. These features are not a claim of independent certification or perfect compatibility with every browser and assistive technology. Reports of barriers help guide corrections.
